_comment: Spells, adapted from SRD 5.1 (CC-BY-4.0) to fights on a grid of five-foot squares. kind decides what it does (attack, auto, save, heal, buff, condition, sleep, stabilize, cure, summon, guardian, aura, zone, move, revive, identify). target decides how it is aimed: enemy, ally, downed_ally, dead_ally (one creature in range and in sight), self, all_allies (friends within range, up to 'count'), point (a square in range and in sight: the centre of a sphere, cylinder or cube, or where something appears), direction (a cone, line or cube starting at the caster), item. range: feet, or touch, or self. area: {shape: sphere, cylinder, cube, cone or line; size: feet - radius, side or length}. Areas catch everyone in them, friend or foe, unless affects says enemies or allies. cast: action (the default), bonus or reaction. concentration: ends if the caster is hurt and fails a Constitution save, or casts another. Extra effects: ignites (sets dry ground burning), leaves (a zone left behind for leaves_rounds), push (feet, on a failed save), zone (web, fog: what it lays), slows (feet of speed lost), no_reactions, no_heal, ignores_cover, count, radius, budget.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.text: A mote of fire flung at one foe up to 120 feet away.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.text: A beam of numbing cold; the target loses 10 feet of speed until its next turn.

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.text: Lightning from your hand: easier against metal armour, and they cannot strike back as you step away.

chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
chill_touch.text: A ghostly hand that withers flesh; it cannot be healed until your next turn.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.text: Three darts of force that never miss, up to 120 feet.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.text: A 15-foot fan of flame from your hands. Dry grass catches.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.text: A thunderclap in a 15-foot cube beside you; whoever fails the save is hurled 10 feet away.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.text: Everyone in a 20-foot sphere falls asleep, weakest first, until 5d8 hit points' worth are sleeping. Friends too.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: A reaction: when a blow would land, +5 AC until your next turn. Cast by itself when it would turn the blow.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armour
mage_armor.text: Your AC becomes 13 + Dex while unarmoured, for eight hours.

identify.name: Identify
identify.text: Ten minutes with a strange thing, and you know what it is, what it does and whether it is cursed. Not in a fight.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.text: Three rays of fire, each aimed separately.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.text: Freezes a person where they stand (concentration; they try to shake it off each turn). Blows from beside them are criticals.

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.text: A bonus action: vanish and reappear in a free square you can see up to 30 feet away.

web.name: Web
web.text: Sticky webs fill a 20-foot cube: hard going, and whoever is caught is held fast (concentration).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.text: A bead of fire that bursts in a 20-foot sphere. Everyone in it burns, friend or foe.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.text: A stroke of lightning 100 feet long and 5 wide, through everyone in its way.

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.text: Hail like stones over a 20-foot circle, which stays treacherous underfoot for a round.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.text: Skin hard as stone: resistance to weapon damage.

hold_monster.name: Hold Monster
hold_monster.text: Freezes any living creature (concentration; it tries to shake it off each turn).

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.text: Radiant fire falls on one foe up to 60 feet away; cover does not help them.

spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare_the_dying.text: A touch stops a dying ally from bleeding out.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.text: Heals by touch, and eases one wound.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.text: A bonus action: a word of power that heals someone up to 60 feet away.

bless.name: Bless
bless.text: Up to three allies within 30 feet add 1d4 to attacks and saves (concentration).

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.text: A flash of light; the next attack on the target has advantage.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.text: A bonus action: +2 AC to one ally (concentration).

command.name: Command
command.text: One word, 'Grovel!', and they throw themselves down.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.text: A bonus action: a floating weapon of force appears and strikes; each turn after, a bonus action moves it 20 feet and strikes again.

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.text: Ends a poison, blindness or a disease.

spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit_guardians.text: Spirits wheel around you for 15 feet: enemies who come into them or start their turn there burn, and wade as through deep water (concentration).

mass_healing_word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass_healing_word.text: A bonus action: heals every ally within 60 feet a little.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.text: Brings back someone dead less than a minute, with 1 hit point. Needs a diamond worth 300 gold.

guardian_of_faith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardian_of_faith.text: A faceless guardian in armour appears up to 30 feet away and strikes at every enemy who comes within 10 feet of it, until it has dealt 60 damage.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.text: The first blow that would kill them leaves them standing at one hit point instead.

mass_cure_wounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
mass_cure_wounds.text: Heals and eases a wound on every ally within 60 feet.

flame_strike.name: Flame Strike
flame_strike.text: A column of divine fire, 10 feet across, wherever you choose within 60 feet.
